facts.text: Audrey has a group of animals referred to as 'my fur babies'.
Audrey's animals include at least one dog and a teddy bear.
Audrey's animals enjoy playing in the garden and running around.

evidence.quote: Yeah, they do enjoy the garden! Always running around, exploring and having a great time.
So cute to see them snuggled up, having fun together.

facts.text: Audrey's animals bring her a great deal of joy and love.
